This lavish grilled dish makes liberal use of high-quality cuts of meat.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meats are made by [[Cooking]] either [[Raw Gourmet Meat]] or a [[Raw Whole Bird]] together with [[Rock Salt]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. [[Link]] can eat them to heal some of his [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. These [[Meal]]s are considered to be lavish, making using of high-quality [[Meat]]s. Link can add extra ingredients while Cooking Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat, which can result in the following variations: * '''Hearty Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
This lavish grilled dish makes liberal use of high-quality cuts of meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty ingredients. They can be eaten to heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him temporary Hearts. * '''Energizing Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
This lavish grilled dish makes liberal use of high-quality cuts of meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing ingredients. When consumed, they'll replenish part of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Enduring Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
This lavish grilled dish makes liberal use of high-quality cuts of meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring ingredients. Link's Stamina Wheel will be completely restored and overfilled when he eats these meats. * '''Hasty Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
This lavish grilled dish makes liberal use of high-quality cuts of meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty ingredients. These meals will grant Link a boost to his movement speed when he eats them. * '''Spicy Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
This lavish grilled dish makes liberal use of high-quality cuts of meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy ingredients. By eating them, Link will gain one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Electro Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
This lavish grilled dish makes liberal use of high-quality cuts of meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric ingredients. If they're eaten, Link will receive one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Mighty Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
This lavish grilled dish makes liberal use of high-quality cuts of meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty ingredients. By eating them, the power of Link's attacks will be boosted. * '''Tough Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
This lavish grilled dish makes liberal use of high-quality cuts of meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough ingredients. They can be eaten to increase Link's defensive abilities. * '''Sneaky Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
This lavish grilled dish makes liberal use of high-quality cuts of meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky ingredients. Link's [[Stealth]] will be boosted when he eats these meals. * '''Chilly Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
This lavish grilled dish makes liberal use of high-quality cuts of meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding chilly ingredients. When eaten, they will grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Like in {{BotW}}, Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meats can be made by [[Cooking]] [[Rock Salt]] with either [[Raw Gourmet Meat]] or a [[Raw Whole Bird]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The [[Recipe]] for Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat is earned by completing the [[Quest]] "[[Relieving Meat Fatigue]]". It is made using twelve [[Raw Gourmet Meat]]s and twelve [[Rock Salt]]s, but this can be lowered to nine of each through the completion of "[[Hungry Hunches]]". When prepared before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]], the [[Warrior]]s deal 12% more damage. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal * Salt-Grilled Meat * Salt-Grilled Prime Meat }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Salt-Grilled Food |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
